name: ephemeral_persistent_colony
composition_logic: short-lived workers externalize coordination state into a shared environment so colony continuity does not depend on individual identity

name: generational_architect
composition_logic: current agents sense environmental pressure and select structurally different successor forms at lifecycle boundaries

name: phase_switching_swarm
composition_logic: independent agents switch into quorum-governed collective mode after workload density crosses a regime boundary

name: environment_first_agent
composition_logic: agents primarily modify the intake environment so later tasks become cheaper to classify, route, or solve

name: predictive_ambush_agent
composition_logic: continuously predict future opportunity windows but keep expensive action dormant until a qualified trigger occurs

name: ecological_product_family
composition_logic: a stable kernel emits environment-specific successor variants using niche adapters

name: leaderless_elastic_colony
composition_logic: group size and allocation change through local stay/leave dynamics while the whole policy can phase-switch under load

name: metamorphic_security_architecture
composition_logic: each stage uses a short-lived role with distinct tools and permissions; continuity is artifact-based, not identity-based
